how.title: How to use these resources
how.step1_text: Each theme gathers labs and presentations on one topic, with a short description of every document.
how.step2_text: Notebooks open directly in Google Colab, no installation needed. PDFs open in the built-in viewer.
how.step3_text: Download the files, adapt them to your institution and credit the source: AfDB – Data Innovation for Africa.

about.title: About Data Innovation for Africa
about.text1: Data Innovation for Africa (DI4A) is an initiative of the African Development Bank's Statistics Department. It helps national statistical offices, central banks and public institutions harness new data sources — satellite imagery, big data, artificial intelligence — to produce timelier, more granular statistics for policy.
about.text2: This site shares the training material produced by the DI4A team: reproducible notebooks, presentations and step-by-step guides. Everything is free to reuse with attribution.
about.pillar1_text: Every lab runs end-to-end from a single parameter, in the cloud or on your laptop.
about.pillar2_text: Materials are provided in English and French whenever possible.
about.pillar3_text: Content under CC BY 4.0, code under MIT. Cite "Source: AfDB – DI4A".
